status: prospective choices agreed before execution; code and final freeze pending

task.population: Complete census of six labels by eight positions per delay; no novel content/generalization claim.
task.optimization_sampling: Private paired draws with replacement over48label-positionpairs; one uniformdelay in0,1,2 perbatch. Batch32neednotbe balanced; census48is balanced.
task.census_order: target label outer ascending, cue position inner row-major

optimization.selection: Mean DEV accuracy over delays3 and4 descending, then mean CE ascending, then LRascending.
optimization.preflight_admission: Both DEV-selected family pilots must reach at least0.95accuracy atdelay2 on the48-row census. If either fails, retain complete negative preflight and do not run main. No extra tinyfit, rescue or automaticbudget escalation.
optimization.design_amendment: Pilotupdates increased prospectively from512to1024 before any code execution or outcomes; main2048unchanged.

interventions.state_boundary: After cue and all gap frames, immediately before addition/processing of identical query
interventions.zero: Zero retained state or GRU hidden state; preserve query, weights, delay and all tensor/runtime settings.
interventions.swap: Cyclic donor label within same cue position; record original target and donor target. Both natural stored states.

interference.distractor_labels: All six answers independently crossed with target and cue position
conditions: next of eight cue positions cyclically
interference.blank_control: Same48label-positionpredictions repeated across6independentdistractors or equivalently labelledbalancedcensus

stratum_interpretation.same_label: Re-exposure of target; not conflicting interference.
stratum_interpretation.different_label: Conflicting distractor; 240rows and target-vs-intruder accuracy reported.

interventions.cases: normal at7delays; cueerased/zero/swap atdelays2and8; blankrepeated/samepos/nextpos atdelay8;16cases percheckpoint.
interventions.swap_donor_row: (recipient_row+8)%48; donor label changes cyclically, cueposition fixed.

estimands.within_family: delay8-minus-delay2 pairedaccuracy; descriptive unless explicitly frozen as secondary
estimands.intervention_interpretation: Require intact competence before treating a drop as evidence of lost retrievable content. A failed model cannot establish robust forgetting/repair.
estimands.current_only_bound: With six balanced targets and identical cue-free suffix, fixed deterministicweights/state cannot exceed1/6censusaccuracy; nonanswerpredictioncan yield0. This is a logical bound, not an empirical measurement.

memory_allocation.scope: Tensor payload sizes only; parameter matching does not match state allocation, measured information capacity, peak process memory or energy.
